reason: An LLM orchestration plugin that aggregates router, parallel advisor, and final model calls with provider failover, streaming, credential configuration, privacy filtering, and cost controls.

summaries.zh: 通过路由器、并行参考顾问和聚合器编排多次大模型调用，并提供流式输出、故障切换、隐私过滤与费用控制。
summaries.en: Orchestrates router, parallel advisor, and aggregator LLM calls with streaming output, provider failover, privacy filtering, and cost controls.

capabilities: Routes LLM requests through a multi-stage router, parallel reference-advisor, and aggregator pipeline
Sends request content to DeepSeek and optionally OpenCode Go endpoints
Reads and uses configured API keys or environment-variable credentials
Tracks usage and applies budget, frequency, and interval limits
Provides provider failover and configurable privacy filtering
